plan.schedule: Constant1e-6 for both arms, continuing the final parent learning rate
plan.tile_rule: seeded choice among grid tiles with at most 1 % of sites at or above the source white
plan.sigma_estimator: sqrt(a*max(box5(noisy),0)+b) per plane, noisy input only
plan.training_tiles: non-overlapping 512-site grid, tiles_per_source chosen per source
plan.development_tiles: the 18 archived native v002 development patches
limits: ISO100 single frames are clean proxies with their own residual noise, not truth
Unique ISO100 R6 III frames from days other than the development, burst and chart days; many frames share scenes; development patches already inspected; no final test
Target white 14351 measured at ISO16000 is assumed for 3200, 6400 and 51200; black 2048
Shot slopes are descriptive fits; spectrum equivalence not demonstrated (15 of 20 inconclusive)
ISO51200 real variance 2.6 to 5.0 % above the simulator
Dark deviations keep read, row, column and fixed pattern of calibration frames; control frames for development
No 12800/25600 (no lit slope), no 60D, no Bayer augmentation, no saturation mask in the loss
Existing x - sigma*F adapter kept; adapter ablation and comparators (BM3D, classical IPR) not in this run
Two continuations of one initialization, known development only
No dataset, simulator, sampling, adapter, gradient threshold or optimizer reset between arms
Sigma floor equals one native DN; sigma from noisy input, never from clean target
Independent hardlinks to read-only arrays; parent arrays and checkpoint must stay immutable

continuation.optimizer: Restore identical Adam moments and step counter
continuation.random_state: Restore identical data generator, CPU and CUDA RNG state in each arm
